title: BLANK_VALUE
description: If the value is blank, evaluates the substitute values in order and returns the first non-blank value; otherwise, returns the original value. A value is considered blank if it is NULL, empty, contains only whitespace, or evaluates to $SKIP_ASSIGNMENT.

parameters.name: ...substitute_value
parameters.description: One or more substitute values to fall back on when the provided value is blank; the first one that is not blank is returned.

examples:
BLANK_VALUE(Rating, "No Data")
-- Returns "No Data" if Rating is NULL or blank; otherwise, returns Rating.
